hidden_reference_use: final offline correctness only; never a policy feature

policies.all_applicable_pass: accept only when interface, refs and executable program checks all pass
policies.risk_logistic: logistic model on deployment features fitted only on dev; threshold selected on dev

threshold_selection.constraint: conditional wrong-delivery rate no more than strong-rule dev rate plus 0.01

decision_rule: continue policy research only if risk_logistic Pareto-improves coverage or cost at no more than +1pp conditional wrong delivery versus all_applicable_pass; otherwise stop complex policy
